turnstile.error: Human check failed, reload the page and try again

privacyNote: By continuing you accept the privacy notice: the trial lasts 72 hours, the archive ZIP is kept for 7 days afterwards.

code.label: 6-digit code (valid for 10 minutes)
code.exhausted: Too many attempts, request a new code
code.notReceived: Didn't get it? Check your spam folder, or

signup.title: Create account
signup.headline: Start with your e-mail
signup.note: No password, no credit card. When the trial ends your data is packed as a ZIP and the download link is e-mailed to you (valid 7 days); the account is deleted right away.
signup.closed: Today's sign-ups are full, please try again tomorrow

passkey.prompt: Verify with one of your registered passkeys
passkey.unsupportedTitle: This browser does not support passkeys
passkey.unsupported: The platform admin signs in with WebAuthn (passkeys). Use a current Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox; there is no other sign-in method.

passkeyFailed: Passkey verification failed or was cancelled, please try again
setupCodeInvalid: The setup code is wrong or already used; contact operations

setup.caption1: Enter the setup code and bind passkey #1
setup.intro: The first sign-in needs the one-time setup code from operations.
setup.codeLabel: Enter the setup code from operations
setup.codeHint: The setup code stops working once bound
setup.secondIntro: A second passkey is required so you cannot lose access (use another device or a security key). You will first verify with passkey #1.

recovery.fileTitle: Platform admin recovery codes (each works once)
recovery.intro: Save these 10 recovery codes; they are shown only once. Use one if you lose all passkeys.
recovery.saved: I have saved these recovery codes
recovery.loginIntro: If you lost all passkeys, sign in with one recovery code, then bind a new passkey right away.
recovery.useCode: Lost your passkeys? Use a recovery code

ended.title: Your data is packed
ended.titleAccent: The download link is in your inbox
ended.body: We packed your workspace data into one ZIP in object storage and sent the download link to the e-mail you signed up with. Click the link in the e-mail to download directly, no sign-in needed. The link is valid for 7 days; then the ZIP is deleted for good.
ended.archivedText: ZIP archive (B2 object storage, server-side encrypted)
ended.sentText: Download link and "delete now" link (sent once)
ended.notReceived: No e-mail? Check your spam folder. The account is deleted, so the link cannot be sent again.

archiveDeletion.title: Delete the archive now
archiveDeletion.body: After confirming, the ZIP archive is deleted from object storage at once and the download link in the e-mail stops working. This cannot be undone.
archiveDeletion.confirm: I confirm permanently deleting this archive now; the e-mailed download link will stop working
archiveDeletion.done: The archive is deleted and the download link in the e-mail no longer works.
archiveDeletion.invalid: This link has expired or the archive was already deleted
